questions.question: b757's close stopped at step [22], the scores close, with nothing written: the sealed reader tools/standing/act.py :82 compares the FINDINGS line the findings bank names with the bank's head character for character, and raised "FINDINGS.md :15436 does not read the bank`s head" (data/b757_findings.json :3). The head carries two backticks that the landing turned into ’ by its one conversion, whose rule (tools/b652_record.py :35-:36) is that every landing and every look-up of a landed line goes through it; this reader does not. Read by a scratch reader that writes nothing: through the conversion the line equals the head and the reader takes all 48 of its lines; the same reader passes b749, b752, b754, b755 and b756, whose heads carry no backtick; at the next line it still refuses. Every route to steps [22] to [25] (the scores close, the mirror, the scores line and the closing record) runs this reader, and the ways past it are an edit of a sealed standing tool or a rewrite of the pushed findings bank, both barred by N4. The rest of the close stands: the pre-push suite 116 run, 110 passing (data/b757_checks.txt :16), the post-push suite the same (data/b757_checks_postpush.txt :16), the six failing the five declared on the face and G-TRAIL-CARRIES-SEAL; the scores as banked at step [9] N1, N2, N4, N5 and S3 HELD, N3 REFUTED, S1 and S2 PENDING. Which way does the close go?

options.label: Stop at [22], carry the rest (Recommended)
options.description: The close stops at [22] with nothing edited or rewritten after the lock: no scores close, mirror, scores line or closing record by the sealed tools at b757. The seat's closing message prints the halt and every post-lock finding with its time, and the next ruling orders the reader's repair and the four steps carried. No score is lost on this route; the scores stand as banked at step [9].

options.label: Repair the reader, then close
options.description: One Edit of tools/standing/act.py :82 so the bank's head is read through the landing's one conversion, VERSION moved, its controls planted (b757 and the five earlier acts read, the next line refused) and the standing dry run again over it, which rewrites a bank written before the lock; committed with phase record, then steps [22] to [25] by the sealed order. Its costs: N4 REFUTED, a tool and a bank edited after the lock gate, and N5 REFUTED, a sealed tool not agreeing at the record.
